title: Feature creep: Added sailing to my open world skateboarding game
author: Brave-History-6502
selftext:
[https://fjordfall.fly.dev/](https://fjordfall.fly.dev/)

I've been working on this and posting about it for a while. I added sailing as a way to get to new regions and places to downhill skate/explore. There was probably an easier way to add new areas to the game, but sailing is also something popular in norway, where the game is set.

How do you all balance features vs refinding the existing gameplay when ai makes it so tempting to just add one more feature? Where do you draw the line when your engineers always say yes?

I think I bias towards always saying yes and then often end up with too much or half-baked ideas. I'd be curious if there are any design principles that help with this.
